_comment: #3941 追加候補（2026-11-27）。チェキ C31〜C42（みんと。台紙・窓は本編 cg_minto_first_cheki と同じ位置）、プリクラ P31〜P42（640×1080 の2コマ）。text は余白・落書きに手書きで入れる言葉（各キャラの正本の呼び方・口調に合わせた）。

cheki.title: 両手でハート
cheki.pose: facing the camera, making a heart shape with both hands in front of her chest, bright happy smile
cheki.text:
はじめくん
いつもありがと♡

cheki.title: ほっぺにピース
cheki.pose: facing the camera, a peace sign held against her cheek, playful wink with her tongue slightly out
cheki.text:
今日も来てくれて
うれしいっ♪

cheki.title: 小悪魔のツノ
cheki.pose: facing the camera, both index fingers pointing up beside her own devil horns as extra little horns, teasing grin showing a tiny fang
cheki.text:
小悪魔に
ご注意♡

cheki.title: ミントのひと枝
cheki.pose: facing the camera, holding a small fresh mint sprig near her lips, one eye closed, gentle smile
cheki.text:
ミント
ましまし♡

cheki.title: 投げキッス
cheki.pose: facing the camera, blowing a kiss from her fingertips, eyes closed happily, slight head tilt
cheki.text:
ずっと
まってるね♡

cheki.title: 指ハート
cheki.pose: facing the camera, leaning forward a little and making a finger heart toward the lens, confident wink
cheki.text:
推してくれて
ありがと♡

cheki.title: 頬づえ
cheki.pose: sitting at the cafe counter, resting her chin on both hands, looking up at the camera with a sweet smile
cheki.text:
みんとに
会いにきてね

cheki.title: フラミンゴ・ピーチ
cheki.pose: facing the camera, holding up a tall glass of pink peach soda drink with a paper straw beside her face, winking
cheki.text:
フラミンゴ・ピーチ
推し♡

cheki.title: 2ショット・半分こハート
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Minto and Hajime side by side, each making half of a heart with one hand so the halves meet between them; Minto beams, Hajime smiles shyly
cheki.text:
2ショット
記念日♡

cheki.title: 2ショット・かたいピース
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Minto doing a big cheerful peace sign; Hajime standing rigidly upright like a soldier, arms stiff, a tiny awkward peace sign at chest height, tense closed-mouth expression with a drop of sweat — clearly NOT smiling naturally
cheki.text:
かたいよ〜？
次は笑ってね

cheki.title: 2ショット・ツノのいたずら
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Minto standing slightly behind Hajime, holding two fingers up behind his head like little devil horns; Hajime looks at the camera surprised
cheki.text:
はじめくんも
悪魔の仲間♡

cheki.title: 2ショット・肩を並べて
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Minto and Hajime shoulder to shoulder (not touching cheeks), both smiling at the camera, Minto doing a peace sign
cheki.text:
相性
ばっちり♡

cheki.title: がおーポーズ
cheki.pose: facing the camera, both hands raised like little claws beside her face in a playful 'rawr' pose, mischievous grin showing a tiny fang
cheki.text:
がおー♡
つかまえた

cheki.title: 敬礼ウインク
cheki.pose: facing the camera, a cute little salute at her temple with one hand, winking, the other hand on her hip
cheki.text:
本日も
ご来店感謝♡

cheki.title: ほっぺにハート
cheki.pose: facing the camera, both hands making small hearts pressed against her cheeks, eyes closed in a big happy smile
cheki.text:
ほっぺに
ハート♡

cheki.title: 2ショット・ドリンク
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Hajime holding a tall glass of pink peach soda with a paper straw, a little embarrassed; Minto beside him pointing at the drink and winking
cheki.text:
ちゃんと
飲んでね♡

cheki.title: 黒フチ・特別な日
cheki.frame: a glossy BLACK card (black instant-film frame) instead of white
cheki.ink: gold and silver metallic gel-pen handwriting
cheki.pose: facing the camera, one hand lightly at her heart choker, confident half-lidded smile with a tiny fang
cheki.text:
特別な日の
みんと♡

cheki.title: ハート柄フチ
cheki.frame: a pastel PINK card printed with small white and darker-pink hearts
cheki.pose: facing the camera, both hands cupped under her chin in a cute 'burikko' pose, sparkly eyes
cheki.text:
かわいく
撮れた？

cheki.title: ミントのギンガムフチ
cheki.ink: deep green and pink paint-marker handwriting
cheki.pose: facing the camera, holding a small potted mint plant toward the lens with a proud smile
cheki.text:
ミント
育ててます♪

cheki.title: 全身ver.
cheki.pose: FULL-BODY shot from the top of her horns down to her boots, standing in the cafe, a little curtsy pinching her skirt hem, winking
cheki.text:
全身ver.
レアだよ♡

cheki.title: 顔アップ
cheki.pose: a very close-up shot where her face fills most of the photo, big wink, a peace sign right next to her eye
cheki.text:
近すぎ？
えへへ♡

cheki.title: ハートのふうせん
cheki.pose: facing the camera, holding the string of a mint-green heart-shaped balloon floating beside her head, leaning playfully to one side
cheki.text:
ふうせん
あげるっ♡

cheki.title: 撮る側のみんと
cheki.pose: facing the camera, holding a small instant camera herself and aiming it back at the viewer with one eye closed, playful
cheki.text:
次は
はじめくんの番

cheki.title: 2ショット・おそろいのツノ
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Hajime wearing a small headband with black devil horns (it sits on top of his cap) that Minto put on him, looking embarrassed; Minto beside him pointing at his horns and laughing
cheki.text:
おそろいの
ツノ♡

cheki.title: 2ショット・背中あわせ
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Minto and Hajime standing back to back with arms crossed in a 'cool' pose, Minto winking, Hajime trying to look serious
cheki.text:
クール
コンビ？笑

cheki.title: 2ショット・はじめのハート
cheki.pose: two-shot cheki: Hajime awkwardly making a heart with both hands, Minto leaning in and pretending to catch the heart with both hands, delighted
cheki.text:
ハート
いただきっ♡

cheki.title: 雨の日
cheki.pose: inside the cafe on a rainy day, rain on the window behind her, holding a closed clear umbrella with raindrops, slightly damp bangs, warm smile
cheki.text:
雨の日も
ありがと♡

cheki.title: イベント衣装案・天使の日
cheki.pose: a one-day 'angel day' event costume: the same dress redrawn in WHITE with mint-green frills, small white feathered angel wings instead of bat wings and a thin golden halo, but she keeps her small black devil horns peeking out (a devil playing angel); playful prayer hands
cheki.text:
天使の日
限定♡

purikura.title: あげはとギャルピ伝授
purikura.top: Ageha and Hajime both doing the gyaru peace sign (palm turned inward, fingers under the chin), Ageha perfect and confident
purikura.bottom: Ageha laughing and correcting Hajime's hand, Hajime's gyaru peace is clumsy
text: ハジメっち へた笑
purikura.theme: hot pink and leopard print gyaru frame, glitter hearts, bear stamps

purikura.title: あげはと半分こハート
purikura.top: Ageha and Hajime each making half of a heart with their hands so it joins between them
purikura.bottom: both laughing with eyes closed, Ageha leaning on Hajime's shoulder
purikura.theme: neon pink and gold, sparkle stars, heart stamps

purikura.title: あげはと盛れ顔
purikura.top: both making exaggerated cute pouty faces at the camera
purikura.bottom: Ageha playfully pinching Hajime's cheek while he flinches, both grinning
purikura.theme: pastel lilac and mint checkerboard frame, lipstick and star stamps

purikura.title: 組長と記念の一枚
purikura.top: Kanzaki stands stern with arms crossed, Hajime stiff and nervous beside him
purikura.bottom: Kanzaki gives an awkward small peace sign, Hajime bursting into laughter
text: あんちゃんと 記念ですわ
purikura.theme: cream and wine-red frame with gold laurel stamps, a little old-fashioned

purikura.title: クラウドと闇プリ
purikura.top: Kuraudo in a dramatic visual-kei pose with a hand over one eye, Hajime trying to copy it
purikura.bottom: both breaking into laughter, Kuraudo's pose fallen apart
purikura.theme: black and deep burgundy frame with lace, roses, crosses and bat stamps

purikura.title: ソロぷり初挑戦
purikura.top: Hajime alone, standing stiffly, not sure where to look
purikura.bottom: Hajime alone, a shy small peace sign and a faint smile, getting used to it
purikura.theme: sky blue and white frame with camera and sparkle stamps

purikura.title: ましろとゆるぷり
purikura.top: Mashiro and Hajime both sleepy-eyed and relaxed, Mashiro tilting her head
purikura.bottom: Mashiro yawning behind her sleeve, Hajime smiling at her
text: はじめくんと ゆるぷり
purikura.theme: soft sage green and cream gingham frame, rabbit and cloud stamps

purikura.title: つむぎの似顔絵
purikura.top: Tsumugi shyly hugging her tablet, Hajime beside her looking at the camera
purikura.bottom: Tsumugi holding up a quick cute sketch of Hajime on paper, Hajime surprised and laughing
purikura.theme: lavender frame with pencil, eraser and paint stamps, sketchbook paper texture

purikura.title: サメちゃんとサメぷり
purikura.top: Same-chan and Hajime both putting a flat hand on top of their head like a shark fin
purikura.bottom: Same-chan doing a playful chomp pose with her shark plush, Hajime pretending to be bitten
purikura.theme: ocean blue frame with waves, bubbles, coral and shark-tooth stamps

purikura.title: 鳴と勝負の一枚
purikura.top: Naru and Hajime staring each other down competitively, foreheads not touching
purikura.bottom: the two doing a fist bump and laughing
purikura.theme: navy and orange sporty frame with checkered flag and lightning stamps

purikura.title: ひよりとないしょの一枚
purikura.top: Hiyori leaning in playfully toward the camera, Hajime surprised
purikura.bottom: both smiling softly, Hiyori's high ponytail swinging
purikura.theme: teal and cream frame with small rain-drop and star stamps

purikura.title: スミさんと師匠と弟子
purikura.top: Sumi and Hajime both with arms crossed, serious master-and-apprentice faces
purikura.bottom: Sumi ruffling Hajime's cap with a big hand, both laughing
purikura.theme: warm brown cafe frame with coffee bean, cup and mosaic-lamp stamps

purikura.title: ヨルとセッション
purikura.top: Yoru tapping out a rhythm with her headphones half on, Hajime nodding along awkwardly
purikura.bottom: the two grinning at the camera, Yoru resting an arm on Hajime's shoulder like a cool older friend
text: はじめくんと セッション♪
purikura.theme: dark purple club frame with sound-wave lines, music notes and vinyl record stamps

purikura.title: 凛想とたまには
purikura.top: Rio calm and languid with a small cool smile, Hajime stiff beside her
purikura.bottom: Rio gently tilting Hajime's cap brim with one finger, both smiling
purikura.theme: calm slate blue and white frame with small leaf and ribbon stamps

purikura.title: あげはと変顔対決
purikura.top: both pulling silly funny faces at the camera (puffed cheeks, crossed eyes) — playful, not ugly
purikura.bottom: both collapsing into laughter
purikura.theme: yellow and hot pink pop frame with comic burst and star stamps

purikura.title: あげはと組長と3人で
purikura.top: three people: Ageha in the middle doing a gyaru peace, Kanzaki on the right stern with arms crossed, Hajime on the left nervous
purikura.bottom: Ageha pulling Kanzaki and Hajime close, Kanzaki giving in with a reluctant small peace sign, Hajime laughing
purikura.theme: pink leopard and gold frame with crown and heart stamps

purikura.title: tonariの3人
purikura.top: three people: Sumi on the left with arms crossed, Tsumugi in the middle shyly hugging her tablet, Hajime on the right
purikura.bottom: all three smiling, Sumi with a hand on Hajime's cap, Tsumugi giving a small peace sign
purikura.theme: warm amber frame with colorful mosaic-lamp and coffee stamps

purikura.title: 私服のみんと（栞）とないしょの一枚
purikura.top: Shiori (Minto off duty, in plain clothes) shyly hiding half of her face behind her hand, Hajime surprised to see her
purikura.bottom: Shiori with a small, tired but warm smile and a tiny peace sign held close to her chest, Hajime smiling gently
purikura.theme: soft cream and dusty-green frame with small leaves, a teacup and a tiny heart; quiet and modest, very few stamps

purikura.title: つむぎと初プリ
purikura.top: Tsumugi standing stiffly, unused to purikura, hugging her tablet; Hajime pointing at the camera to show her where to look
purikura.bottom: Tsumugi smiling shyly with a small peace sign, Hajime grinning
text: はじめさんと 初プリ
purikura.theme: soft lavender frame with pencils, a small sketchbook and flower stamps

purikura.title: サメちゃんとコロちゃんの記念
purikura.top: Same-chan holding her crowned shark plush Koro-chan up proudly between herself and Hajime
purikura.bottom: Koro-chan the plush 'biting' Hajime's cap while Same-chan looks surprised at her own plush
text: 余と勇者の 記念である
purikura.theme: deep blue frame with waves, a small crown, bubbles and shark-tooth stamps

purikura.title: ひよりとあわの一枚
purikura.top: Hiyori gazing slightly away with a dreamy, fragile expression, Hajime glancing at her
purikura.bottom: Hiyori suddenly smiling brightly at the camera with a peace sign, Hajime laughing
purikura.theme: pale aqua frame with floating soap bubbles and small sparkle stamps

purikura.title: 凛想とモルモットくんの記録
purikura.top: Rio holding a small notebook as if observing Hajime for research, Hajime stiff
purikura.bottom: Rio leaning in close beside Hajime with a subtle satisfied smile, pen tapping her lips
text: モルモットくんの 記録
purikura.theme: slate blue frame with graph-paper lines, a tiny flask and leaf stamps

purikura.title: アダムとダブルアップル
purikura.top: Adam staring at the camera with a dead-serious face, holding up two apples (one red, one green); Hajime confused beside him
purikura.bottom: Adam still serious while Hajime laughs, Adam pressing the two apples together into a heart-ish shape
text: ダブルアップルか それ以外か
purikura.theme: red and green frame with apple and leaf stamps, a little stylish

purikura.title: 鳴とポーズ勝負
purikura.top: Naru and Hajime each striking a cool pose, competing
purikura.bottom: both breaking into laughter, Naru with an arm around Hajime's shoulder
purikura.theme: black and orange street-style frame with lightning and star stamps

purikura.title: 組長と左右そろった指ハート
purikura.top: Kanzaki making a finger heart with perfect craftsman precision, checking that both sides are symmetric; Hajime making a sloppy one
purikura.bottom: Kanzaki gently correcting the angle of Hajime's finger heart, both now perfectly matched
text: 左右 そろえやした
purikura.theme: cream and deep purple frame with gold laurel and small heart stamps

purikura.title: あげはとクラウドと3人で
purikura.top: three people: Ageha in the middle, Kuraudo on the right in a cool visual-kei pose, Hajime on the left; the photo is NOT whitened or skin-brightened so Kuraudo's black and wine-red stay deep
purikura.bottom: all three smiling, Ageha has drawn a single small heart on Kuraudo's shoulder
purikura.theme: black, wine-red and pink frame with lace, roses and small heart stamps
